_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the dependency gate (scripts/audit-gate.js). Each entry: advisory (the GHSA URL npm audit reports), reason, reviewedBy, expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days ahead). An expired entry blocks again.

exceptions.reason: picomatch ReDoS on crafted extglob patterns; no patched release exists (all <= 4.0.7). A dev-only dependency of Vite (via fdir and tinyglobby), run at build time on the project's own glob patterns; it is not in the installer, the cloud server image or any code that handles user input. Upgrade as soon as a patched version is released.
